entities.summary: Danielle Rodrigues Lins, better known as Dani Lins, is a Brazilian volleyball player who plays as a setter. She represented her country at the FIVB World Grand Prix 2009 in Tokyo, Japan, where they won the gold medal. In 2012, she became an Olympic champion at the 2012 Summer Olympics.
